cohort: 1854 breech infants born at 23-24 6/7 weeks' gestation in California, Missouri, and Pennsylvania from 2000-2009
finding: While cesarean delivery increased overall survival, it also led to higher rates of major morbidity in breech periviable neonates.
mod_finding: Among intubated neonates, despite a short-term survival advantage with cesarean delivery, there was no difference in 6-month survival.
